correctness.rationale: At nonzero times, Galois action reduces zeros to U,S_p,S_q. The rational cyclotomic map Q^(pq)→Q(zeta_pq) has kernel dim p+q−1: its additive row+column matrices span that kernel. A {0,1} additive matrix is a coordinate cylinder, yielding primitive-zero rigidity; nonprimitive zeros require uniform corresponding CRT column/row sums. Coprime p,q make simultaneous uniform sums imply empty/full. Inclusion-exclusion yields all seven exact zero sets and each displayed spectral-rank polynomial, with t=0 treated separately (empty J only). Independently enumerated exact cyclotomic residue tests on all 64+1024+16384+32768 masks at N=6,10,14,15 using different Gray-code updates; recovered zero-free totals 36,740,12824,30030. These finite masks do NOT prove the all-pq result; the kernel and counting argument does.
residual_risks: Finite tests alone are not a universal proof.
